value="Gerencia | 10.4x.1.0/24 (VLAN 101, WPA3-Ent)
• 7 planned staff workstations (14M down / 3.5M up)
• Reports web and center management app
• Gateway: 10.4x.1.1 (Perimeter Firewall)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="375" x="75" y="185" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="z_soporte" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;spacingLeft=10;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="Soporte | 10.4x.2.0/24 (VLAN 102, WPA3-Ent)
• 7 planned staff workstations | Center support &amp; IT
• Gateway: 10.4x.2.1 (Perimeter Firewall)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="215" width="375" x="75" y="320" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_ground_station" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#3b82f6;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#1e3a8a;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Drone Ground Station | 10.4x.2.10/32
• Preloads mission packages (order, polygon, no-fly)
• Multipart upload: photos, maps, flight records
• Bandwidth: 5M down / 20M up gtd (burst 61.5M up)
• Uploads reach application &amp; object_storage tiers" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="345" x="90" y="380" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="z_logistica" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;spacingLeft=10;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="Logística | 10.4x.3.0/24 (VLAN 103, WPA3-Ent)
• 22 planned clients: 2 wired desks + 20 mobile scanners
• Bandwidth guarantee: 44M down / 11M up (100% active)
• Sack reception (accept/reject), custody, code sheets
• Gateway: 10.4x.3.1 (Perimeter Firewall)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="375" x="75" y="550" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="z_servidores" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;spacingLeft=10;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="Servidores locales | 10.4x.10.0/24 (VLAN 110, Wired)
Network devices, printing and commissioning zone" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="305" width="375" x="75" y="705" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_net_devs" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f3ff;strokeColor=#8b5cf6;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#5b21b6;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Network Management Infrastructure (.1 to .49):
• Firewall Mgmt: .1 | PoE Switches: .2-.9 | APs: .20-.49
• Managed from Cloud Administration (TCP 22/443)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="345" x="90" y="755" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_printers" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Network Code-Sheet Printers (.50 to .59):
• Dedicated Ethernet printers for sack code sheets
• Inbound IPP TCP 631 from Logística &amp; Staff" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="75" width="345" x="90" y="835" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_laptop" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffbeb;strokeColor=#f59e0b;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#92400e;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Commissioning Laptop (.60) [TEMPORARY AUDIT]:
• 10.4x.10.60/32 on dedicated wired switch port
• TCP 22/443 for initial setup before VPN (CC-ADM-06)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="75" width="345" x="90" y="920" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="z_isolated_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff1f2;strokeColor=#f43f5e;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;spacingLeft=10;fontColor=#881337;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="INTERNET-ONLY ISOLATED CONTEXT (VRF)
Quote: "Visitor VLAN does not route to logistics or management" (Case statement point 3)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="255" width="375" x="75" y="1025" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="z_transporte" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Transporte | 10.4x.4.0/24 (VLAN 104, WPA3-Pers)
• 20 planned transporter phones | Cap: 20M down / 5M up
• Client isolation; breakout to public API front door" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="85" width="345" x="90" y="1085" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="z_visitantes" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Visitantes | 10.4x.5.0/24 (VLAN 105, WPA3-Pers)
• 10 planned guest phones | Cap: 10M down / 2.5M up
• Client isolation; general web breakout (TCP 25 blocked)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="85" width="345" x="90" y="1180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="center_barrier_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#334155;fontSize=10;" value="Center Inter-Zone Policy Controls (Summary):
• CC-GST-01..03: Visitantes &amp; Transporte denied to private LANs [AUDIT]
• CC-ADM-03..04: Client zones denied to mgmt; printers never initiate [AUDIT]
• CC-STF-03: Staff zones denied to other LANs (Matrix A11 sec 6) [REVIEW]
• Full policy evaluation tables: docs/firewall-policy.md" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="375" x="75" y="1295" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fw_device" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#3b82f6;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=10;spacingLeft=12;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" value="CENTER PERIMETER FIREWALL (10.4x.20.1) | Link to the Cloud" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1240" width="395" x="595" y="185" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fw_services" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#3b82f6;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#1e3a8a;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Local Gateway Services (Priority 1):
• Gateway IP: 10.4x.Z.1 on all VLAN subinterfaces
• DHCP Server: UDP 67 (Staff 12h, Yard 4h, Guest 1h)
• DNS Cache / Forwarder: UDP 53 (upstream Route 53 Resolver)
• Local NTP Server: UDP 123 (synced to cloud / pool.ntp.org)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="135" width="365" x="610" y="235" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fw_shaping" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#3b82f6;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#1e3a8a;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Traffic Control &amp; Bandwidth Shaping (Section 8):
• Priority 1: Network Control (Tunnels, DNS, NTP, RADIUS, Logs) -> 2M/2M gtd
• Priority 2: Logistics (Receiving, scanning, code sheets) -> 44M/11M gtd
• Priority 3: Drone Ground Station (Missions, multipart uploads) -> 20M/5M gtd
• Priority 4: Staff Workstations (Center management, reporting) -> 28M/7M gtd
• Priority 5: Non-operational capped pool (Transport, Guests) -> 30M down max" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="175" width="365" x="610" y="385" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fw_wan1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f3ff;strokeColor=#8b5cf6;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#5b21b6;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Primary WAN Interface (10.4x.20.1 on VLAN 120):
• 100 Mbps symmetric fiber link (90 Mbps usable)
• Site-to-Site VPN: 2 IPsec Tunnels to TGW Hub (CC-LNK-01..03)
• IKEv2, UDP 500/4500, IP 50 (ESP), AES-256-GCM" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="365" x="610" y="575" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fw_wan2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffbeb;strokeColor=#f59e0b;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#92400e;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Cellular Backup WAN Interface (LTE / 4G Router):
• Automatic failover upon primary link failure (ASM-078)
• Re-establishes 2 IPsec tunnels behind carrier NAT
• Non-operational traffic suppressed to 0 during failover" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="365" x="610" y="710" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fw_execution_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#334155;fontSize=10;" value="Top-Down Policy Evaluation Summary (Section 4):
• 1. CC-GST-01..03: Deny Guest/Transport to Admin &amp; LANs [AUDIT]
• 2. CC-ADM-03..04: Deny Clients to Mgmt; Deny Printers Initiating [AUDIT]
• 3. CC-BAS-01..04: Allow Gateway Services, RADIUS &amp; Syslog [AUDIT]
• 4. CC-LOG / CC-STF / CC-DRN: Allow Cloud Traffic over Tunnel [AUDIT]
• 5. CC-LNK: Allow Site-to-Site VPN; Temporary QA Route [AUDIT]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="170" width="365" x="610" y="835" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cc_def_block" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fef2f2;strokeColor=#ef4444;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#991b1b;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="CC-DEF-01: Explicit Default Deny All (Pre-prod Audit)
• Final rule drops unmatched packets; stateful replies allowed
• Rejected flows logged locally and exported to CloudWatch Logs" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="365" x="610" y="1020" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pub_internet_boundary" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=12;spacingLeft=15;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;" value="PUBLIC INTERNET &amp; EXTERNAL CLIENTS" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="360" width="520" x="1060" y="135" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ext_farm" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Farm Field Nodes (200 Farms in Cauca, Huila, Tolima):
• Crop &amp; drying telemetry: 6 readings/day (150B MQTT)
• Connects to AWS IoT Core over TCP 8883 / 443 ALPN" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="480" x="1080" y="185" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ext_users" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Public Mobile Clients (Farmer &amp; Transporter Apps):
• Transporter 5-min GPS &amp; custody events (1 KB HTTPS)
• Farmer sack registration; AWS WAF &amp; Cognito JWT auth" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="480" x="1080" y="260" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ext_lookup" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Public Sack Lookup Consumers:
• End-buyers scanning QR codes (CloudFront CDN + WAF)
• Rate-limited 30 reads/min per source IP (PD-102)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="480" x="1080" y="335" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ext_services" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="External Services &amp; Municipal Drone Ingress:
• Municipal seat drone operators (signed presigned S3 URLs)
• External NTP pool servers (pool.ntp.org)
• Local breakout exit for center web &amp; update traffic" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="480" x="1080" y="410" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hub_tgw_boundary" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#8b5cf6;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=12;spacingLeft=15;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;" value="AWS NETWORK ACCOUNT | Central Transit Hub" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1070" width="520" x="1060" y="515" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hub_badge_d05" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dcebf7;strokeColor=#52708a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="D05" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="55" x="1515" y="525" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tgw_header" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f3ff;strokeColor=#8b5cf6;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#5b21b6;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="AWS Transit Gateway (tgw-aroma-hub)
Central hub interconnecting 3 collection centers and workload VPCs" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="480" x="1080" y="565" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tgw_vpn" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f3ff;strokeColor=#8b5cf6;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#5b21b6;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="AWS Site-to-Site VPN Connections (CL-LNK-06) [AUDIT]:
• 3 center VPN connections (2 tunnels each, static routes)
• IKEv2 only, certificate-based auth / PSK, IP 50 ESP" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="480" x="1080" y="640" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tgw_rt_centers" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f3ff;strokeColor=#8b5cf6;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#5b21b6;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="TGW Route Table 'centers' (Inbound from Centers):
• Routes to 4 pdn tiers: application, storage, admin, drone [AUDIT]
• 10.40.0.0/13 inter-center BLACKHOLE (no lateral transit) [AUDIT]
• 10.80.0.0/16 dev BLACKHOLE (dev isolated from centers) [REVIEW]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="125" width="480" x="1080" y="745" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tgw_rt_pdn" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f3ff;strokeColor=#8b5cf6;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#5b21b6;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="TGW Route Table 'pdn' (Inbound from pdn VPC):
• Static routes: 10.41/16, 10.42/16, 10.43/16 to VPN attachments [AUDIT]
• Remaining 10.40.0.0/13 BLACKHOLE (unassigned center ranges)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="480" x="1080" y="880" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tgw_rt_dev_qa" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f3ff;strokeColor=#8b5cf6;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;spacingLeft=8;fontColor=#5b21b6;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="TGW Route Tables 'dev' and 'qa':
